component.name: QLever UI
component.summary: User-friendly interface for the QLever SPARQL engine

developer.name: University of Freiburg, Chair for Algorithms and Data Structures

description.p: QLever UI is an easy-to-use interactive user interface for the SPARQL search engine QLever. It helps to discover the scopes and information in very large knowledge bases.

ul.li: Write SPARQL queries with context-sensitive suggestions and auto-completion
Show different types of results, such as geographical data, named instances and images
Customize the interface for the needs of its users and the structure of the dataset

description.p: QLever (pronounced "Clever") is a graph database that implements the RDF and SPARQL standards. It can efficiently load and query very large datasets on a single commodity PC or server.

screenshot.caption: SPARQL query editor with context-sensitive suggestions
